comment: Help > Welcome opens the window with its middle on the main window's, the first time and every time after, with the subwindows embedded and with each window its own. With them off the second open stood in the host's top-left corner, because every show of a window of its own is a new OS window whose position is read back as (0, 0). The dump's windows array carries the window's position and size and root_window_size the main window's, so the centre is read in numbers as well as on the shot. A capture run does not meet the boot's own copy, so the boot's open and its following of the main window are the suite's business.
